title: Drive bearing seizure
root_cause: Bearing ran dry due to blocked grease line; vibration climbed for 6 days before seizure.
resolution: Replaced bearing, cleared grease line, added vibration alarm at 6.0 mm/s.

title: Belt mistracking
root_cause: Idler misalignment caused edge wear and repeated trips.

title: Mechanical seal failure
root_cause: Seal face wear allowed coolant leak; temperature rose 18%.
resolution: Replaced cartridge seal, flushed cooling jacket.

title: Impeller cavitation
root_cause: Suction strainer fouling dropped inlet pressure, cavitation pitted impeller.
resolution: Cleaned strainer, balanced and refit impeller.

title: Spool sticking
root_cause: Contaminated oil caused mold valve spool to stick, casting defects appeared.
resolution: Replaced spool, fitted 10-micron filter, drained reservoir.

title: Internal leakage
root_cause: Worn seals caused pressure droop and slow mold oscillation.
resolution: Reseal kit fitted, verified oscillation profile.

title: Tooth pitting
root_cause: Oil analysis showed iron particles; pinion pitting from overload.
resolution: Replaced pinion, switched to ISO VG320 oil, set load trip.

title: Work roll thermal crack
root_cause: Cooling spray header partially blocked, roll surface cracked.
resolution: Reground roll, cleared spray header nozzles.

title: Electrode arm overheating
root_cause: Clamp contact resistance rose, arm temperature elevated.
resolution: Cleaned clamp contacts, retorqued to spec.

title: Coupling wear
root_cause: Elastomeric coupling degraded, vibration rose on caster supply.
